acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO for plastic surgeons leverages artificial intelligence to analyze patient search patterns, competitor strategies, and market trends to optimize a practice's online visibility. The goal is to improve organic search rankings, attract more qualified leads, and ultimately increase patient inquiries and bookings by understanding and adapting to the nuances of local and specialized medical searches.
